note: shadcn/ui drag-and-drop form builder; one page per prebuilt form template, /template/<category>/<form> (102 templates in 15 categories: business Job Application …, travel Hotel Booking …). Every template page carries the full category→template nav, so /template/business/job_application is the URL source (the site's own sitemap only lists the 6 marketing pages). Three slugs repeat across categories (insurance_claim, newsletter_signup, vendor_application), so each keeps one item; the other two drop as duplicate ids. /components, /builder, /faq, /about are app/marketing pages, not templates.
